- Intro: TCP congestion control is end-to-end, sender limits in-flight data to avoid network overload. Uses congestion window (cwnd) and receiver window (rwnd); effective window min(cwnd, rwnd). cwnd measured in bytes or MSS. Sender can send up to min(cwnd, rwnd) unacknowledged bytes.
- State variables: cwnd, ssthresh, RTT estimate, retransmission timer.
- Basic principle: increase cautiously when no loss, decrease sharply on loss. Loss signals congestion (packet drop or duplicate ACKs).
